name: Yami to Boushi to Hon no Tabibito Typing Traveller
original_name: ヤミと帽子と本の旅人 タイピングトラベラー
source:
Main character's librarian sister got sucked into some book. Protagonist dives into different book worlds in order to rescue his sister.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的图书管理员姐姐被吸进了一本书中。为救回姐姐，他闯入一本又一本书里的世界，踏上穿梭不同故事的冒险。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-june-2004-3days-michiteyuku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
